title: Influence of delayed initiation of therapy on the course of disease in hepatocellular carcinoma
summary: The cause of the chronic liver disease, serum total bilirubin level and time between initial diagnosis/presentation to the interdisciplinary tumor board and initiation of local therapy are to be analyzed. All these data will be evaluated anonymously with the parameters from the pre-therapeutic staging examinations collected by several different consultants.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of liver and intrahepatic bile ducts

interventions.name: The hospital's electronic database will be searched for all patients who received a diagnosis of HCC. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- HCC patients ≥18 years
- Presence of multiphasic cross-sectional imaging (MRI and CT) at initial diagnosis and immediately prior to local therapy
- No additional treatment of HCC prior to local therapy
Exclusion criteria:
- Incomplete or insufficient imaging that impairs correct image interpretation (e.g. due to artifacts or lack of the correct contrast agent phases).
